Message:
“Thank you, Fortina.
Now, let’s get through this...
together...!”

Her voice sounds different now.
As if some weight upon her heart
had finally lifted.

Aah...! It looks like my thoughts
reached your heart.

Now brimming with light,
the lance in Florence’s hands
shatters the boulders,
unsealing the cave entrance.

My feet carried me
swiftly towards Florence,
when she pulled me
tightly into her arms.

But in the very next moment,
I heard a sinister growl
from right behind me.

Gripped with fear,
I forced myself to look back,
then saw all of the
cursed creatures surrounding us...

Once again...
I’m only making things
harder for Florence...
I knew it—I can’t ever...!

After all,
you always end up
having to protect me.
Even now...

“There’s no one better than you.
Your trust gives me
the strength to fight.

After all we’ve
been through together,
there’s no foe who can
stand a chance against us.”

“Together”...
For the longest time...
I’ve always wanted to
hear you say that...!

I had always envied the others...
For they were
the ones you’d turn to.

But, each and every time,
I wanted to be
the one you turned to.

But now, at last...
I feel that I have finally
found my place beside you.
